name: keyflow-navigator
description: 键盘驱动的沉浸式内容浏览
interaction: Users navigate a content landscape using only keyboard inputs — arrow keys shift focus between nodes, while modifier keys trigger depth transitions (zooming into topics or pulling back to overview). Each keystroke triggers subtle visual feedback — parallax shifts, ambient sound cues, and typographic animations — creating a fluid, game-like reading experience that keeps hands on the keyboard and eyes on the content.
